CustomField.description: Likert Matrix sections (#144, Number mode): API name of an updateable number field on the form object that stores the running total score. The matrix dispatches a formfieldchange for this field whenever an answer changes while Show_Total_Score__c is enabled, and clears it to null when no rows are answered. The builder offers only updateable number-typed fields that are not matrix rows. Distinct from Form_Component_Field__c.Alternative_Field__c, which overrides a field's related-field mapping.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional field that saves the matrix total score to the record whenever an answer changes. Choose a number field that is not one of the matrix rows; leave blank to show the total without saving it.
CustomField.label: Alternative Field
